name: interface-members-and-assertions
description: An interface no declaration names as a type is reported, and the concrete type that satisfies it stays live through its own method. An interface a function takes as a parameter type is not reported, the method a call site invokes through it is not reported, and the method nothing invokes through it is. A compile-time assertion whose interface nothing else names as a type is reported, the interface's own method is reported beside it because the assertion is not a call, and the concrete method that satisfies the interface is not reported.
